title: China's Ministry of Commerce launches anti-discrimination investigation into U.S. IC measures
discussion_signal: The post circulates MOFCOM's announcement of an anti-discrimination investigation into U.S. measures affecting China's integrated-circuit sector. The signal shows export controls becoming reciprocal legal and diplomatic instruments, not only unilateral technology restrictions.
linked_research_question: How do technology restrictions become reciprocal state instruments that reshape legitimacy, market access, and strategic competition?
limits: The post reports an investigation launch, not its final findings
State-media framing may emphasize official legitimacy
An investigation does not establish legal merits or market effects
